title: Risk assessment method for instruction and electronic equipment

pse.problem: Inefficient and risk-prone instruction auditing method for electronic equipment due to single machine checking and manual rechecking
pse.solution_function: A federal learning architecture-based risk assessment method that constructs an instruction risk joint assessment model, performs risk evaluation on instruction data, protects data privacy, avoids original data leakage, improves accuracy, and increases efficiency.
pse.solution_structure: The solution consists of child nodes and a fusion node. Each child node is equipped with an instruction execution module, an evaluation module, and a local instruction risk assessment model. The fusion node constructs the instruction risk joint assessment model based on the models trained by each child node.
pse.solution_implementation: Each child node trains its local instruction risk assessment model based on instruction type risk and instruction parameter compliance risk. The fusion node constructs an instruction risk joint assessment model using the trained models from each child node, evaluates the instruction data of each child node, and outputs the risk level of the instruction data. The child node executes the instruction based on the risk level and a preset execution program, and optimizes the program based on the evaluation result.
pse.effect: Improved accuracy and efficiency in instruction auditing, enhanced data privacy protection, and reduced original data leakage risks
